name: Simeon Yetarian
description: Simeon Yetarian: Losco concessionario armeno alla Premium Deluxe Motorsport, specializzato in recupero crediti e furti d'auto (Repo).
features: Repossession assignments and export deliveries
High-priority vehicle drop-offs paid in cash at the docks
Classic contact missions & Premium Deluxe Repo Work

name: Lester Crest
description: Lester Crest: La brillante mente criminale dietro le più grandi rapine e speculazioni di borsa di San Andreas.
features: Heist planning for Paleto Score, The Big Score, and Diamond Casino Heist
Phone service to remove wanted levels
Cyber intelligence hub for The FIB Files

name: Lester Crest (House)
description: Lester Crest: La brillante mente criminale dietro le più grandi rapine e speculazioni di borsa di San Andreas.
features: Stock market assassination missions for Michael and Franklin on BAWSAQ / LCN
Secret cyber intelligence safehouse
Initial planning meetings for The Jewel Store Job
income: Stock market manipulation and portfolio investments

name: Lamar Davis
description: Lamar Davis: Migliore amico d'infanzia di Franklin e caotico membro delle Families a Forum Drive.
features: Lowriders missions for Benny's Original Motor Works
Mugger phone service to harass other players
Cultivation and delivery jobs for LD Organics
income: Neighborhood contracts and LD Organics payouts

name: Martin Madrazo
description: Martín Madrazo: Potente boss del cartello Madrazo presso il lussuoso ranch La Fuente Blanca. Assegna contratti di assassinio ed estorsione.

Special dispatch assassinations
Access to the Cayo Perico Heist via his son Miguel Madrazo
income: Pagamenti in contanti dal Cartello Madrazo

name: Trevor Philips
description: Trevor Philips: Imprevedibile sociopatico e spietato leader della Trevor Philips Enterprises nella contea di Blaine.
features: Hub of Trevor Philips Enterprises on Zancudo Avenue
Mission base for Series A Funding and Humane Labs Heist
Rural airstrip and helicopter landing pad nearby
income: Regional smuggling from Trevor Philips Enterprises

name: Ron Jakowski
description: Il fedele e paranoico braccio destro di Trevor, teorico della cospirazione e conduttore radiofonico. Coordina il contrabbando aereo via hangar (Smuggler's Run) e funge da collegamento con i Fooliganz.
features: Direct contact for airborne cargo theft and hangar operations
Opening liaison for the Los Santos Drug Wars storyline
Classic aviation contact missions
income: Commissions on air cargo contraband shipments

name: Michael De Santa
description: Michael De Santa: Leggendario ex rapinatore di banche nel programma protezione testimoni dell'FIB, residente nell'esclusivo quartiere di Rockford Hills.
features: Main estate featuring private tennis court, pool, and multi-car garage
Heist planning meetings and film producer contacts
Safehouse in Rockford Hills
income: Movie producer royalties and major heist cuts
